content.short: Solayer is a native restaking layer on Solana that provides stake-weighted Quality of Service (QoS) for dApps.
content.description:
Solayer is a pioneering decentralized restaking protocol built natively on the Solana blockchain, designed to enhance network security and provide guaranteed performance for decentralized applications. By allowing users to restake native SOL or Liquid Staking Tokens (LSTs) such as JitoSOL, the protocol issues sSOL, a highly composable liquid derivative. This approach enables participants to earn multiple layers of yield while securing external modules like oracles, bridges, and Layer 2 solutions.

A unique value proposition of Solayer is its "Stake-Weighted QoS" mechanism, which allows dApps to secure dedicated network bandwidth and transaction priority on the Solana L1 by utilizing restaked capital. The platform focuses on professional-grade risk management and transparent on-chain execution, serving as a primary infrastructure layer for the next generation of high-frequency Solana applications. Through its commitment to innovative decentralized security, Solayer is empowering participants to build more robust and efficient decentralized portfolios while maximizing their asset utility.
